title: HouseCairn export of a home, format 2
description: `manifest` describes manifest.json; `documents` describes data/<app>.json, one per app the manifest lists. See Administration > Export and deletion.

members.description: Kept for the owners; not restored: memberships are made again from the people the restore matches.

pending_invitations.description: Kept for the owners; not restored: an invitation is a link sent by e-mail, which only its secret opens.

calendar_feeds.description: Kept for the owners; not restored: the address of a feed is a secret that is not kept.
